producer.WorldGenesis: authorizes seed, region, terrain, and settlement placement
producer.SettlementForge: plans lots, materializes exteriors, binds authored interiors and stations

consumers.NPC04: read-only station anchors, capacity, access_state, identity. NPC04 owns actor movement, occupancy assignments and AI
consumers.Economy: read-only trade/work stations; Economy owns wallets, prices, items and transactions
consumers.Crowd: read-only roads, zoning, destinations; Crowd owns ghost agents
consumers.UniversalLibrary: future recipe supply; Settlement Forge executes recipes after validation
consumers.Journey: read-only stable building_id, locations and objective anchors
consumers.HUD_Map: interior flag and building ID; host owns presentation

transition.host_authority: Convergence V4 save_progress/JourneySave and existing institutional transition must be reconciled before integration
transition.entry_call: enter(player, exterior_root, staging_root, camera, building, authorized_by_host)
transition.recovery_call: restore_from_core(player, exterior_root, staging_root, camera, building, snapshot, authorized_by_host)

security: No independent production save, no untrusted path or self-authorized access. Physical reachability requires native physics/nav validation.
